- core/store.py: sms_status.json mutable; outbox/sms.jsonl append-only.
- scripts/stock_report.py: scripts that send payments or SMS... (warning about irreversible actions, audit logging).

Note: queue_sms re-renders text from template+params and assigns new phone from registered household — same message and details as original. Re-sending failed messages: read sms_status.json for "failed" entries, match to sent_messages() by id, re-queue with same template_id and params (queue_sms will re-render text and use registered phone). Exactly one new text per failed message; don't re-send delivered ones.
